function_frame.description: Function prologue, stack frame and epilogue (NASM)
body: push rbp                 ; save the caller's frame pointer
mov rbp, rsp              ; rbp now points at the saved rbp
sub rsp, 64               ; reserve 64 bytes for locals

syscall.description: Raw Linux x86-64 syscall, number in rax
body: ; the syscall number goes in rax, the arguments in rdi, rsi, rdx
mov edx, message_len      ; number of bytes to write

syscall_stdio.description: read and write syscalls moving data to and from a buffer
body: ; read(0, buffer, size): rax receives the number of bytes read
; write(1, buffer, count): rax receives the number of bytes written
mov edx, rax              ; reuse the byte count returned by read

array.description: Initialised array of values with an element count

function_calls.description: Direct call to a function and an indirect call via a pointer
body: call strlen              ; rax = length of the string in rdi

body: mov rax, [rel counter@GOTPCREL]   ; address of the global
mov eax, [rax]                     ; value stored in the global
